text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
How's everything going with
you-know-what,
Kawakami?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you're referring to when I broke the

doorknob! Well, since I put plants in my
room like
you said to, I do feel more at
peace!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
That's great! Houseplants are really
effective
when it comes to calming bad
qi. ☆

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
And if you have any problems, Akebono,
I can
use feng shui to help you out
too! ☆

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Me? Hmm... I don't think I'm struggling
with
anything...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Oh, actually...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Hi-YAHHH! I must clean every nook and
cranny!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: This is all for my friend! Yaaah! I really hope she wins!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Hehe. ♪ Even the table's shiny now!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: And the sink is sparkling!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: How's this, Rickey?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
It's looking good! By keeping your
surroundings
clean, you can attract the
luck you need to win! In
terms of feng
shui, this is perfect!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, thanks! I feel like I'm one step
closer to
getting a meal voucher for that
famous sumo stew
joint! ☆

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I-I've just finished cleaning over here as
well!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Okay, now that we're all here, let's try
our luck!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: ...Aww, that's too bad!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Ngh... The wall of probability was too
thick to
smash through!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I knew we couldn't change the preset
odds of
winning, but I thought if we
could just change our
luck...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I thought that if we approached this with
positive
qi then it might work out. I'm
sorry...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Hey, it's okay. ☆ And the cafe's spotless
now, so
that's great!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
That's very true! And it was such good
training
that my arms are throbbing!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: You guys...

text_block_list.name: Cafeteria Lady
text_block_list.text: Oh! There you are!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: U-us?

text_block_list.name: Cafeteria Lady
text_block_list.text:
You three even got those stubborn oil
stains out!
Thank you all so much.

text_block_list.name: Cafeteria Lady
text_block_list.text:
Actually, I have a few meal vouchers for
this place
my friend owns, so I'd like you
to have them!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
W-wait, aren't these vouchers for that
sumo stew
place?!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Wow... Haha. ♪ Cleaning the place up
really did
bring something good our way!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I hope I can call on you for help again
sometime,
Rickey. ♪

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
...So, that's what happened! I'm really
glad I was
able to help them!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Before training, Copano Rickey shares a

heartwarming story about her and her
classmates.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Those two are both so sunny, and
they're strong,
too. I feel like just being
around them gives me
strength!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
All three of them are powerful in
different ways,
and I imagine they have
plenty of other things in
common too. I
can't help hoping this trio's bond
stays
strong.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! All the more reason to keep
polishing my
feng shui skills!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I want to use feng shui to bring heaps of

happiness to all my precious pals, after
all! ♪
